subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw replace the current one-active-memory-plugin direction with a supported multi-role, per-agent memory-routing taxonomy, or retain the single-owner model and extend plugins through narrower APIs?
rationale: This choice changes the enduring core configuration and plugin contract across memory, hooks, runtime dispatch, diagnostics, SDK surfaces, and upgrade behavior; code review cannot determine the intended product model from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Retain one memory owner
options.body: Keep the current single-slot direction and pursue any missing recall, capture, dreaming, or modeling capability through focused plugin APIs or owner plugins.

options.title: Sponsor a role taxonomy
options.body: Approve the multi-role direction through a memory-owner design/RFC decision, defining role semantics, ownership, migrations, and external plugin compatibility before a narrowed follow-up implementation.

recommendation.title: Retain one memory owner
recommendation.body: Keep the current single-slot direction and pursue any missing recall, capture, dreaming, or modeling capability through focused plugin APIs or owner plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: Memory taxonomy and formal-model ownership are explicitly assigned to this area.
